round_goal: Run the full harness, identify the highest-signal failures across prompt, UX, and deploy tiers, then patch the smallest set of files needed to restore green status.

priorities.title: Gather harness evidence
priorities.action: Run `python harness/scripts/run_all_harness.py --rounds 15` and inspect `harness/RESULTS.md`, tier JSON reports, and any relevant logs/screenshots to isolate the first real failure in each tier.

priorities.title: Fix Tier 1 and Tier 2 regressions first
priorities.action: Patch prompt templates, backend prompt-loading code, and static HTML only where the reports show a concrete regression. Preserve required placeholders, metadata, and accessibility basics.

priorities.title: Verify deploy safety and rerun
priorities.action: Run compile/tests after edits, confirm no import-time regressions, then rerun the harness and update `harness/RESULTS.md` with the best result from the round.

generator_prompt: You are working in C:\policy under the harness loop instructions. First read the latest harness reports and identify the single highest-signal failure per tier. Then make the smallest safe edits in prompts/, backend/, or static/ to satisfy the failing criteria without breaking placeholders, metadata, or tests. After editing, run the compile/test checks and rerun the full harness, then update harness/RESULTS.md with the outcome.
